en.understanding: John opens his Gospel by taking us back before time itself began - "In the beginning." The "Word" he's talking about is Jesus, who has always existed alongside God the Father. This verse declares something amazing: Jesus isn't just divine, He IS God - equal in nature, power, and glory with the Father.
en.livingItOut: When life feels uncertain or overwhelming, remember that Jesus has been in control since before the beginning of time. You can trust Him completely because He's not just a good teacher or prophet - He's God Himself who knows and cares about every detail of your life. Let this truth give you confidence to bring any situation to Him in prayer.
en.godsLove: What incredible love that God would choose to become human for us! Jesus didn't have to leave heaven's glory, but He did because of His deep love for you and me. This verse shows us that our salvation wasn't an afterthought - it was planned by the eternal God who has always existed in perfect love.

tl.understanding: Si Juan ay nagsimula sa kanyang Gospel sa pamamagitan ng pagbabalik natin sa panahon bago pa man nagsimula ang lahat - "Sa pasimula." Ang "Salita" na kanyang binabanggit ay si Jesus, na laging umiiral kasama ng Diyos Ama. Ang talatang ito ay nagsasabing nakakagulat na bagay: si Jesus ay hindi lamang diyos, Siya AY Diyos - pantay sa kalikasan, kapangyarihan, at kaluwalhatian ng Ama.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag ang buhay ay tila hindi sigurado o nakakapagod, alalahanin na si Jesus ay nasa kontrol mula pa bago nagsimula ang panahon. Maaari mo Siyang pagtitiwalaan nang buo dahil hindi Siya basta guro o propeta - Siya ay Diyos mismo na nakakaalam at nagmamalasakit sa bawat detalye ng inyong buhay. Hayaang bigyan ka ng tiwala ng katotohanang ito upang dalhin sa Kanya sa panalangin ang anumang sitwasyon.
tl.godsLove: Napakagandang pag-ibig na pinili ng Diyos na maging tao para sa atin! Hindi kailangang umalis si Jesus sa kaluwalhatian ng langit, pero ginawa Niya ito dahil sa malalim Niyang pagmamahal sa inyo at sa akin. Ipinapakita sa amin ng talatang ito na ang aming kaligtasan ay hindi isang pagkakataon lamang - ito ay pinlano ng walang hanggang Diyos na palaging umiiral sa sakdal na pag-ibig.

en.understanding: John is emphasizing that Jesus (the Word) has always existed with God the Father from the very beginning of time. This isn't talking about Jesus being created later, but about His eternal existence before anything was made. John wants us to understand that Jesus wasn't an afterthought in God's plan - He was there from eternity past.
en.livingItOut: When life feels uncertain or chaotic, remember that Jesus has been with God since before time began - He's not surprised by your situation. You can trust Him completely because He has eternal wisdom and perspective that goes beyond what you can see. Let this truth give you confidence that He knows exactly what He's doing in your life.
en.godsLove: God's love for you is so deep that Jesus was part of the plan from the very beginning of everything. Before you were born, before the world was created, God already knew you and loved you enough to include Jesus in His eternal design. This shows that your salvation wasn't a backup plan - you were always on God's heart.

tl.understanding: Binibigyang-diin ni Juan na si Jesus (ang Salita) ay laging kasama ng Diyos Ama mula pa sa simula ng lahat. Hindi ito tungkol sa pagkakalikha kay Jesus sa ibang panahon, kundi sa Kanyang walang hanggang pag-iral bago pa man nalikha ang lahat. Gusto ni Juan na maintindihan natin na si Jesus ay hindi naging isang biglang desisyon sa plano ng Diyos - nandoon na Siya mula pa sa walang hanggang nakaraan.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag nagiging malabo o magulo ang buhay mo, tandaan na si Jesus ay kasama ng Diyos mula pa bago nagsimula ang panahon - hindi Siya nagugulat sa sitwasyon mo. Maaari mo Siyang pagkakatiwalaan nang buo dahil may walang hanggang karunungan at pananaw Siya na lampas sa nakikita mo. Hayaan na ang katotohanang ito ay magbigay sa iyo ng kumpiyansa na alam niya talaga ang ginagawa Niya sa buhay mo.
tl.godsLove: Napakalalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos sa iyo na si Jesus ay bahagi na ng plano mula pa sa simula ng lahat. Bago ka pa ipinanganak, bago pa nalikha ang mundo, kilala ka na ng Diyos at minahal ka nang sobra na isinama niya si Jesus sa Kanyang walang hanggang plano. Nagpapakita ito na ang inyong kaligtasan ay hindi spare plan - nasa puso ng Diyos kayo mula pa noon.

en.understanding: John is telling us that Jesus, the Word, was the Creator of everything that exists. This means every star, every flower, every breath you take - Jesus made it all. Nothing in the entire universe came into being without Him, which shows us that Jesus isn't just a good teacher, but God Himself.
en.livingItOut: When you look around today - at the sunrise, your family, even your own hands - remember that Jesus made all of it with love and purpose. This means your life isn't an accident; you were carefully designed by the Creator Himself. Let this truth fill you with wonder and gratitude as you go through your day.
en.godsLove: Think about this: the same Jesus who spoke galaxies into existence chose to become human to save you. He didn't create you and then abandon you - He made you and then gave His life for you. Every beautiful thing around you is a reminder of how much your Creator loves you and wants to be close to you.

tl.understanding: Sinasabi ni Juan na si Jesus, ang Salita, ang lumikha sa lahat ng bagay na umiiral. Ibig sabihin, lahat ng bituin, lahat ng bulaklak, lahat ng hininga mo - ginawa lahat ni Jesus. Walang kahit ano sa buong mundo na nalikha na wala si Jesus, na nagpapakita na si Jesus hindi lang mabuting guro, kundi Diyos mismo.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag tumingin ka ngayon - sa sikat ng araw, sa pamilya mo, kahit sa sarili mong mga kamay - tandaan na ginawa lahat ni Jesus nang may pagmamahal at layunin. Ibig sabihin, hindi aksidente ang buhay mo; maingat kang ginawa ng mismong Lumikha. Hayaang pumasok sa puso mo ang pagkamangha at pasasalamat habang ginagawa mo ang araw mo.
tl.godsLove: Isipin mo: ang parehong Jesus na nagsalita para maging mga galaxy ay pumiling maging tao para iligtas ka. Hindi ka niya ginawa tapos iniwan - ginawa ka niya at nagbigay pa ng buhay niya para sa iyo. Ang bawat magandang bagay sa paligid mo ay paalala kung gaano ka kamahal ng Lumikha mo at gustong malapit sa iyo.

en.understanding: John is telling us that Jesus, the Word, isn't just the Creator - He's the source of all life itself. This "life" isn't just physical existence, but spiritual life that brings meaning, purpose, and connection to God. When John says this life "was the light of men," he means Jesus illuminates our understanding, showing us truth about God and ourselves in a dark world.
en.livingItOut: Since Jesus is your source of life, you can come to Him when you feel spiritually empty or lost. Let His light guide your decisions each day by reading His words and praying for wisdom. When life feels confusing or dark, remember that Jesus doesn't just give light - He IS the light that can brighten any situation you're facing.
en.godsLove: What amazing love - God didn't create us and then leave us to figure things out alone! He gave us Jesus as both our life source and our guiding light. This shows how much God cares about every detail of your existence, wanting you to have not just life, but abundant, meaningful life filled with His presence and direction.

tl.understanding: Sinasabi ni John na si Jesus, ang Salita, hindi lang ang Lumikha - siya rin ang pinagmumulan ng lahat ng buhay. Ang "buhay" na ito hindi lang pisikal na pag-iral, kundi spiritual na buhay na nagbibigay ng kahulugan at koneksyon sa Diyos. Nang sabihin ni John na ang buhay na ito "siyang ilaw ng mga tao," ibig sabihin si Jesus ang nag-iilaw sa aming pag-unawa tungkol sa Diyos at sa aming sarili sa madilim na mundo.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil si Jesus ang pinagmumulan ng inyong buhay, maaari kayong lumapit sa kanya kapag nadarama ninyong walang laman o naliligaw kayo sa buhay. Hayaan siyang gabayan ang inyong mga desisyon araw-araw sa pamamagitan ng pagbabasa ng kanyang mga salita at panalangin. Kapag nalilito o madilim ang pakiramdam ninyo, tandaan na si Jesus hindi lang nagbibigay ng liwanag - siya mismo ang liwanag na makapagpapaliwanag sa anumang sitwasyon.
tl.godsLove: Napakaganda ng pag-ibig na ito - hindi tayo iniwan ng Diyos na mag-isa pagkatapos niya tayong likhain! Binigay niya si Jesus bilang pinagmumulan ng aming buhay at gabay na liwanag. Nagpapakita ito kung gaano niya tayo kamahal, na gusto niya hindi lang tayo mabuhay, kundi magkaroon ng masaganang buhay na puno ng kanyang presensya at patnubay.

en.understanding: John is telling us that Jesus, the Light of the world, keeps shining even when surrounded by spiritual darkness. This darkness represents sin, evil, and everything that opposes God's truth and goodness. The amazing truth is that no matter how dark things get, the darkness cannot put out God's light or defeat it.
en.livingItOut: When you face difficult times, remember that God's light in you cannot be overcome by any darkness around you. Let His light shine through your words, actions, and attitude even in tough situations. You don't have to be afraid of darkness in your life because Jesus' light is stronger and will always win.
en.godsLove: This verse shows us God's incredible love - He didn't leave us in darkness but sent His Son as our Light. Even when everything seems hopeless, God's love keeps shining and never gives up on us. His light in your life is proof that He loves you too much to let darkness have the final word.

tl.understanding: Sinasabi ni John na si Jesus, ang Liwanag ng mundo, patuloy na lumiliwanag kahit napapalibutan ng kadiliman ng kasalanan. Ang kadilimang ito ay tumutukoy sa kasalanan, kasamaan, at lahat ng sumusuway sa katotohanan ng Diyos. Ang magandang balita ay kahit gaano kadilim ang paligid, hindi kayang patayin ng kadiliman ang liwanag ng Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag dumaan ka sa mahirap na panahon, alalahanin mo na ang liwanag ng Diyos sa loob mo ay hindi matatatalo ng anumang kadiliman. Hayaang magliwanag ang Kanyang liwanag sa pamamagitan ng inyong mga salita, gawa, at ugali kahit mahirap ang sitwasyon. Hindi mo kailangang matakot sa kadiliman dahil mas malakas ang liwanag ni Jesus.
tl.godsLove: Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang napakagandang pag-ibig ng Diyos - hindi Niya tayo iniwan sa kadiliman kundi nagpadala ng Kanyang Anak bilang aming Liwanag. Kahit tila walang pag-asa ang lahat, patuloy na lumiliwanag ang pag-ibig ng Diyos at hindi sumusuko sa atin. Ang Kanyang liwanag sa inyong buhay ay patunay na mahal kayo ng Diyos at hindi Niya hahayaang manalo ang kadiliman.

en.understanding: Here we meet John the Baptist, a man with a divine mission. God didn't just let people wonder about the coming Light - He sent a messenger to prepare the way. John wasn't the Light himself, but he was God's chosen witness to point everyone toward Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Like John, God has sent you into your world for a purpose. You don't have to be perfect or famous to be used by God - you just need to be willing. Look for opportunities today to point others toward Jesus through your words, actions, and love.
en.godsLove: God's love is so great that He doesn't leave us guessing about His plans. He sends messengers and prepares our hearts to receive His truth. Just as He sent John to prepare the way for Jesus, God is always working to bring people closer to Him through ordinary people like you and me.

tl.understanding: Nakilala natin dito si Juan Bautista, isang taong may misyon galing sa Diyos. Hindi lang binalaan ng Diyos ang mga tao tungkol sa paparating na Liwanag - nagpadala pa Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang daan. Hindi si Juan mismo ang Liwanag, pero siya ang piniling saksi ng Diyos para ituro sa lahat si Jesus.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan, pinadala ka rin ng Diyos sa mundo mo para sa isang layunin. Hindi mo kailangang maging perpekto o sikat para magamit ng Diyos - kailangan mo lang na handang maglingkod. Maghanap ng pagkakataon ngayong araw para ituro ang iba kay Jesus sa pamamagitan ng inyong salita, gawa, at pagmamahal.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos na hindi Niya tayo pinabayaang maghula-hula sa Kanyang mga plano. Nagpapadala Siya ng mga mensahero at naghahanda ng aming mga puso para tanggapin ang Kanyang katotohanan. Tulad ng pagpadala Niya kay Juan para ihanda ang daan para kay Jesus, patuloy na gumagawa ang Diyos para palapitan ang mga tao sa Kanya sa pamamagitan ng mga ordinaryong tao tulad natin.

en.understanding: John the Baptist had one clear mission: to point people to Jesus, the true Light of the world. He wasn't the main character - he was like a spotlight operator, making sure everyone could see Jesus clearly. God sent John as a witness, someone who would tell others what he had seen and experienced about Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Just like John, we're called to be witnesses who help others see Jesus. This doesn't mean we have to preach on street corners, but we can share how Jesus has changed our lives in simple, genuine ways. When we live with love and tell our story of faith, we're doing exactly what John did - helping people believe.
en.godsLove: How amazing that God wants everyone to believe and know His love! He sent John the Baptist to make sure no one would miss Jesus. God's heart is so full of love that He provides witnesses and helpers to guide us to Him - He doesn't want anyone to walk in darkness when His light is available.

tl.understanding: Si Juan Bautista ay may isang malinaw na misyon: ituro sa mga tao si Jesus, ang tunay na Liwanag ng mundo. Hindi siya ang bida - parang operator siya ng spotlight, sinisiguro na makikita ng lahat si Jesus nang malinaw. Ipinadala ng Diyos si Juan bilang saksi, isang taong magsasabi sa iba ng nakita at naranasan niya tungkol kay Jesus.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan, tayo rin ay tinawag na maging mga saksi na tumutulong sa iba na makita si Jesus. Hindi ibig sabihin nito na kailangan tayong mangaral sa kalye, pero pwede tayong magbahagi kung paano binago ni Jesus ang aming buhay sa simpleng, tapat na paraan. Kapag namumuhay tayo nang may pagmamahal at ikwinento natin ang aming pananampalataya, ginagawa natin ang ginawa ni Juan - tumutulong sa mga tao na maniwala.
tl.godsLove: Ang ganda na gusto ng Diyos na maniwala at makilala ng lahat ang Kanyang pag-ibig! Ipinadala Niya si Juan Bautista para siguruhin na walang hindi makakakilala kay Jesus. Ang puso ng Diyos ay puno ng pagmamahal kaya nagbibigay Siya ng mga saksi at tumutulong para gabayan tayo sa Kanya - ayaw Niyang may maglalakad sa kadiliman habang available ang Kanyang liwanag.

en.understanding: John the apostle is making it crystal clear that John the Baptist wasn't the main character of the story - Jesus is. John the Baptist came as God's messenger, like a friend who points you toward something amazing and says "Look over there!" His whole purpose was to get people ready to meet Jesus, the true Light who would shine into the darkness of our world.
en.livingItOut: Just like John the Baptist, we're called to point people to Jesus, not to ourselves. When God uses you to help someone or when you share your faith, remember it's not about getting credit or praise for yourself. Be like that friend who's excited to introduce others to someone wonderful - let your life be a signpost that says "Check out Jesus!"
en.godsLove: God's love is so generous that He sent John the Baptist ahead of Jesus to prepare hearts and minds. God didn't want anyone to miss meeting His Son, so He gave them a faithful messenger to help them get ready. This shows us that God goes to great lengths to reach us - He's not hiding from us, but actively working to bring us into His light and love.

tl.understanding: Ginawa ni Juan na klaro na si Juan Bautista ay hindi ang pangunahing tauhan ng kuwento - si Jesus ang tunay na bida. Si Juan Bautista ay dumating bilang mensahero ng Diyos, parang kaibigan na nagtuturo sa'yo ng isang kahanga-hangang bagay at nagsasabing "Tingnan mo doon!" Ang buong layunin niya ay ihanda ang mga tao na makilala si Jesus, ang tunay na Liwanag na magliliwanag sa kadiliman ng mundo.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan Bautista, tayo rin ay tinawag na ituro ang mga tao kay Jesus, hindi sa sarili natin. Kapag ginagamit ka ng Diyos para tumulong sa iba o kapag nagbabahagi ka ng pananampalataya mo, tandaan na hindi ito tungkol sa pagkuha ng kredito o papuri para sa sarili. Maging tulad ng kaibigan na excited na ipakilala ang iba sa isang kahanga-hangang tao - hayaan na ang buhay mo ay maging patnubay na nagsasabing "Tignan mo si Jesus!"
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay napaka-generous na nagpadala pa Niya si Juan Bautista bago pa dumating si Jesus para ihanda ang mga puso at isipan. Hindi nais ng Diyos na may makakalimutan na makilala ang Kanyang Anak, kaya binigyan Niya sila ng tapat na mensahero na tutulong sa kanila na maging handa. Ipinakikita nito sa atin na ginagawa ng Diyos ang lahat para maabot tayo - hindi Siya nagtago sa atin, pero aktibong gumagawa para dalhin tayo sa Kanyang liwanag at pag-ibig.

en.understanding: John makes it clear that Jesus is "the true Light" - not just a light, but THE authentic source of spiritual illumination. This light "gives light to every man," meaning Jesus offers understanding and truth to all people, regardless of their background or status. The phrase "was coming into the world" points to Jesus's incarnation, when God became human to bring divine light into our dark world.
en.livingItOut: Since Jesus is the true Light, we can trust Him completely for guidance and truth in a world full of confusing messages. When facing difficult decisions or spiritual darkness, turn to Jesus through prayer and His Word - He promises to illuminate your path. Remember that this same light that transformed your life is available to everyone around you, so share His love with others who are still walking in darkness.
en.godsLove: What amazing love - God didn't leave us stumbling in spiritual darkness! He personally came as the Light to guide every single person toward truth and life. This verse shows us that God's love is universal and personal - He cares about illuminating the path for each individual, including you, with the brilliant light of His Son.

tl.understanding: Pinapakita ni Juan na si Jesus ang "tunay na Ilaw" - hindi lang isang ilaw, kundi ANG tunay na pinagmumulan ng espirituwal na liwanag. Ang liwanag na ito ay "nagbibigay-liwanag sa bawat tao," ibig sabihin naghahandog si Jesus ng pag-unawa at katotohanan sa lahat ng tao, anuman ang kanilang pinagmulan. Ang salitang "dumarating sa mundo" ay tumutukoy sa pagkatao ni Jesus, nang maging tao ang Diyos para dalhin ang banal na liwanag sa aming madilim na mundo.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil si Jesus ang tunay na Ilaw, maaari nating pagkatiwalaan siyang lubos para sa gabay at katotohanan sa mundong puno ng nakakalitong mga mensahe. Kapag nakaharap sa mahihirap na desisyon o espirituwal na kadiliman, lumapit kay Jesus sa panalangin at sa Kanyang Salita - nangako Siyang magbibigay-liwanag sa inyong daan. Alalahanin na ang liwanag na ito na nag-transform sa inyong buhay ay makakamit din ng lahat sa paligid ninyo, kaya ibahagi ang Kanyang pag-ibig sa iba na naglalakad pa sa kadiliman.
tl.godsLove: Napakasakit na pag-ibig - hindi tayo iniwan ng Diyos na natitisod sa espirituwal na kadiliman! Personal Siyang dumating bilang Ilaw para gabayan ang bawat tao tungo sa katotohanan at buhay. Pinapakita ng talatang ito na ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay pangkalahatan at personal - inaalagaan Niya ang pagbibigay-liwanag sa daan ng bawat indibidwal, kasama ka, sa maningning na liwanag ng Kanyang Anak.

en.understanding: This verse reveals the incredible truth that Jesus, the Creator of everything, came to His own creation but wasn't recognized by the people He made. John is showing us the tragedy that the One who spoke galaxies into existence walked among us, yet most people missed who He really was. It's like a famous artist visiting his own gallery, but no one recognizing the master behind all the beautiful paintings on the walls.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes we can be so busy with our daily routines that we miss Jesus working right in front of us. Ask God to open your eyes to see Him in the ordinary moments - in a friend's kindness, in answered prayers, or in His creation around you. Don't let familiarity blind you to the wonder that the Creator of the universe wants to be close to you every single day.
en.godsLove: Even though the world rejected Him, Jesus didn't give up on us - this shows His incredible, persistent love! God could have stayed distant after being unrecognized, but instead He kept pursuing our hearts. This verse reminds us that no matter how many times we've overlooked God or taken Him for granted, His love never stops reaching out to draw us closer to Him.

tl.understanding: Ang talatang ito ay nagpapakita ng kahanga-hangang katotohanan na si Jesus, ang Lumalang ng lahat, ay dumating sa sarili Niyang gawa pero hindi Siya nakilala ng mga taong ginawa Niya. Ipinakikita ni Juan sa atin ang malaking trahedya na ang Siyang nagsalita ng mga bituin ay naglakad kasama natin, pero karamihan sa mga tao ay hindi nakilala kung sino talaga Siya. Parang sikat na artist na bumisita sa sarili niyang gallery, pero walang nakakilala sa master na gumawa ng lahat ng magagandang painting.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan napaka-busy natin sa araw-araw na gawain na nami-miss natin si Jesus na gumagana sa harap natin. Hilingin sa Diyos na buksan ang inyong mata para makita Siya sa ordinaryong mga sandali - sa kabaitan ng kaibigan, sa nasagot na dalangin, o sa Kanyang gawa sa paligid ninyo. Huwag hayaang ang pagiging sanay ay bulagin kayo sa kahanga-hangang katotohanang ang Lumalang ng universe ay gustong malapit sa inyo araw-araw.
tl.godsLove: Kahit tinanggihan Siya ng mundo, hindi sumuko si Jesus sa atin - ito ay nagpapakita ng Kanyang hindi matatawarang, patuloy na pag-ibig! Pwede sanang naging malayo ang Diyos pagkatapos hindi Siya makilala, pero sa halip ay patuloy Siyang humahabol sa aming puso. Pinapaalala sa atin ng talatang ito na gaano man kadami ang beses nating na-overlook o na-take for granted ang Diyos, hindi tumitigil ang Kanyang pag-ibig na abutin tayo para maging mas malapit sa Kanya.

en.understanding: Jesus came to His own people - the Jewish nation whom God had chosen and prepared through centuries of history. Tragically, the very people who should have recognized Him as their long-awaited Messiah rejected Him instead. This verse shows the heartbreaking reality that even those closest to God's promises can miss God when He comes.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes the people closest to us - family, friends, or church members - might not understand our faith journey or relationship with Jesus. Don't be discouraged if those you expect to support you don't always receive your testimony about Christ. Keep loving them and showing Jesus through your actions, trusting God with their hearts.
en.godsLove: Even knowing He would be rejected, Jesus still came to His people because of love. God's love doesn't depend on our response - He loves us even when we turn away from Him. This shows us that God's love is unconditional and persistent, always reaching out to us no matter how many times we've said no.

tl.understanding: Dumating si Jesus sa sarili Niyang mga tao - ang mga Hudyo na pinili at inihanda ng Diyos sa loob ng mahabang panahon. Nakakalungkot na ang mga taong dapat sana ay nakakilala sa Kanya bilang hinihintay nilang Mesias ay tumalikod sa Kanya. Ipinakita ng talatang ito na kahit ang mga malapit sa mga pangako ng Diyos ay maaaring hindi makita ang Diyos kapag dumating na Siya.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan ang mga malapit sa atin - pamilya, kaibigan, o mga kasamahan sa simbahan - ay hindi maintindihan ang ating paglalakbay sa pananampalataya o relasyon kay Jesus. Huwag matakot kung hindi ka maintindihan ng mga inaasahan mong susuportahan ka sa inyong tungkol kay Cristo. Patuloy silang mahalin at ipakita si Jesus sa pamamagitan ng inyong mga gawa, at ipagkatiwala sa Diyos ang kanilang mga puso.
tl.godsLove: Kahit alam ni Jesus na siya ay matatakwil, dumating pa rin Siya sa Kanyang mga tao dahil sa pag-ibig. Hindi umaasa ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa aming tugon - mahal tayo ni Diyos kahit tumalikod pa tayo sa Kanya. Ipinakikita nito na walang kondisyon at matiyaga ang pag-ibig ng Diyos, laging umaabot sa amin kahit ilang beses na tayong tumanggi.

en.understanding: While verse 11 shows the tragedy of rejection, verse 12 reveals the beautiful flip side - those who do receive Jesus get an incredible gift. To "receive" Jesus means to welcome Him and believe in His name, trusting in who He really is. John is showing us that becoming God's child isn't about being born into the right family or following the right rules - it's about believing in Jesus.
en.livingItOut: If you've believed in Jesus, you're already God's child - that's your identity today! This means you can approach God as your loving Father, not as someone far away who might reject you. When doubts come or you feel unworthy, remember that your place in God's family isn't based on your performance but on Jesus and your faith in Him.
en.godsLove: What amazing love - God doesn't just forgive us or help us, He actually adopts us into His family! Even though His own people rejected Jesus, God's heart was still open wide to anyone who would believe. This shows us that God's love isn't selective or exclusive - He genuinely wants a family relationship with each of us.

tl.understanding: Habang ang verse 11 ay nagpapakita ng kalungkutan dahil sa pagtanggi, ang verse 12 naman ay nagpapakita ng magandang balita - ang mga tumanggap kay Jesus ay nakakuha ng napakagandang regalo. Ang "pagtanggap" kay Jesus ay nangangahulugang pagsalubong sa Kanya at paniniwala sa Kanyang pangalan, nagtitiwala sa kung sino talaga Siya. Ipinakikita ni Juan na ang pagiging anak ng Diyos ay hindi dahil sa pinanganak ka sa tamang pamilya o sinunod mo ang mga tuntunin - dahil naniniwala ka kay Jesus.
tl.livingItOut: Kung naniniwala ka kay Jesus, anak ka na ng Diyos ngayon - yan ang tunay mong pagkakakilanlan! Ibig sabihin, pwede mo lapitan ang Diyos bilang mapagmahal mong Tatay, hindi bilang sino na malayo at baka ka tanggihan. Kapag may mga pagdududa ka o nararamdaman mong hindi ka karapat-dapat, alalahanin mo na ang lugar mo sa pamilya ng Diyos ay hindi nakadepende sa ginagawa mo kundi kay Jesus at sa pananampalataya mo sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakagandang pag-ibig - hindi lang tayo pinapatawad o tinutulungan ng Diyos, pero ginagawa pa tayong tunay Niyang mga anak! Kahit na tinanggihan ni Jesus ng sarili Niyang mga tao, bukas pa rin ang puso ng Diyos sa lahat ng manananampalataya. Ipinakikita nito na ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay hindi mapili o eksklusibo - tunay na gusto Niya ng pamilyang relasyon sa bawat isa sa atin.

en.understanding: John explains that becoming God's children isn't about natural birth, human effort, or someone else's decision. This spiritual birth comes only from God Himself - it's His supernatural work, not something we can achieve through family lines, personal willpower, or religious rituals. This verse emphasizes that salvation is entirely God's gift, not based on human ancestry, achievements, or anyone else's choice for us.
en.livingItOut: Rest in the truth that your relationship with God doesn't depend on your background, efforts, or what others think of you. Stop trying to earn God's love through good works or worry about not being "good enough" - He chose you and made you His child. Let this freedom from performance motivate you to live authentically for Him, knowing your identity is secure in Christ.
en.godsLove: What amazing love - God personally chose to make you His child regardless of your past, family, or mistakes! He didn't wait for you to clean up your life first; He adopted you just as you were. This shows how much He values you - not because of what you do, but because of who you are to Him as His beloved child.

tl.understanding: Ipinaliwanag ni Juan na ang pagiging anak ng Diyos ay hindi dahil sa natural na pagkakasilang, sariling sikap, o desisyon ng ibang tao. Ang spiritual na pagkakapanganak na ito ay galing lang sa Diyos mismo - ito'y Kanyang supernatural na gawa, hindi natin makakamit sa pamamagitan ng pamilyang pinagmulan, willpower, o mga relihiyosong gawain. Binibigyang-diin ng talatang ito na ang kaligtasan ay lubos na regalo ng Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: Magpahinga sa katotohanang ang inyong relasyon sa Diyos ay hindi umaasa sa inyong background, mga gawa, o sa tingin ng iba sa inyo. Tumigil na sa pag-try na kitain ang pagmamahal ng Diyos sa pamamagitan ng mabubuting gawa o pag-alala na hindi kayo "sapat na mabuti" - pinili Niya kayo at ginawa kayong Kanyang anak. Hayaang ang kalayaang ito mula sa pressure ay mag-motivate sa inyong mamuhay nang totoo para sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakagandang pag-ibig - personal na pinili ng Diyos na gawing Kanyang anak kayo kahit ano pa ang inyong nakaraan, pamilya, o mga pagkakamali! Hindi Niya hinintay na ayusin ninyo muna ang inyong buhay; nag-adopt Siya sa inyo habang ganyan kayo. Ipinappakita nito kung gaano Niya kayo pinahahalagahan - hindi dahil sa ginagawa ninyo, kundi dahil sa kung sino kayo sa Kanya bilang Kanyang minamahal na anak.

en.understanding: This verse tells us the incredible truth that Jesus, who is "the Word" from verse 1, actually became a real human being and lived among us. When John says "made His dwelling," he literally means Jesus "pitched His tent" with us - like God camping out with His people. John and the other disciples saw Jesus' divine glory with their own eyes, witnessing that He perfectly showed both God's grace (undeserved favor) and truth.
en.livingItOut: Because Jesus became flesh and lived among us, He truly understands our struggles, temptations, and daily challenges. When you face difficulties, remember that Jesus walked in your shoes and knows exactly what you're going through. Let this encourage you to bring everything to Him in prayer, knowing He relates to your humanity while offering His divine help.
en.godsLove: What amazing love this shows - God didn't stay distant in heaven but chose to become one of us! Jesus left the glory of heaven to live in our messy, broken world because He loves us that much. This verse shows us that God's love isn't just words or feelings, but action - He literally moved into our neighborhood to be close to us and show us His heart.

tl.understanding: Sinasabi ng talatang ito ang kahanga-hangang katotohanan na si Jesus, na siyang "Salita" mula sa bersong 1, ay naging tunay na tao at nanirahan kasama natin. Nang sabihin ni Juan na "naging tahanan," literal na ibig sabihin niya ay "nagtayo ng tolda" si Jesus kasama natin - parang nakikipag-camping ang Diyos sa Kanyang mga tao. Nakita nina Juan at ng ibang mga alagad ang banal na kaluwalhatian ni Jesus, na nagpapatunay na perpektong ipinakita Niya ang biyaya (hindi natin deserve na pabor) at katotohanan ng Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil naging laman si Jesus at nanirahan kasama natin, tunay Niyang naiintindihan ang aming mga pakikipagbaka, tukso, at araw-araw na hamon. Kapag nakaharap ka sa mga hirap, alalahanin mo na naglakad si Jesus sa inyong sapatos at alam Niya kung ano ang inyong pinagdadaanan. Hayaang mag-encourage ito sa'yo na dalhin sa Kanya lahat sa panalangin, dahil alam mong nakakaintindi Siya sa aming pagka-tao habang nag-aalok ng Kanyang banal na tulong.
tl.godsLove: Napakagaling ng pag-ibig na ipinakita nito - hindi nanatiling malayo sa langit ang Diyos kundi piniling maging isa sa atin! Iniwan ni Jesus ang kaluwalhatian ng langit para mamuhay sa aming magulo at sirang mundo dahil mahal Niya tayo ng ganoon. Ipinakita ng talatang ito na ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay hindi lang salita o damdamin, kundi aksyon - literal na lumipat Siya sa aming kapitbahayan para maging malapit sa atin at ipakita ang Kanyang puso.

en.understanding: John the Baptist is giving his testimony about Jesus, declaring that even though Jesus came after him in ministry, Jesus is actually greater and existed before him. This seems like a puzzle - how can someone who comes later be from before? John is pointing to Jesus' divine nature, that He existed with God from eternity past. John knew his role was to prepare the way, but Jesus was the eternal Son of God who became human.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, we're called to point people to Jesus rather than seeking our own glory. When we have opportunities to share about Christ, we can follow John's example of boldly declaring who Jesus really is. We don't need to worry about our own reputation when we're lifting up the One who truly matters - Jesus deserves all the honor and recognition.
en.godsLove: God's love shines through in how He sent His eternal Son to become human for us. Jesus didn't stay distant in heaven but came down to our level, even though He existed before all creation. This shows God's incredible heart - He was willing to humble His own Son so we could know Him personally and be saved.

tl.understanding: Nagpapatunay si Juan Bautista tungkol kay Jesus, sinasabi na kahit dumating si Jesus pagkatapos niya sa ministeryo, mas dakila si Jesus at existed na bago pa siya. Parang nakakalito - paano magiging mas nauna yung dumating na huli? Tinutukoy ni Juan ang divine nature ni Jesus, na kasama na niya ang Diyos mula pa sa walang hanggan. Alam ni Juan na ang role niya ay maghanda lang ng daan, pero si Jesus ay eternal Son ng Diyos na naging tao.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan Bautista, tayo rin ay tinawag na ituro ang mga tao kay Jesus kaysa hanapin ang sariling karangalan. Kapag may pagkakataon tayong makakwento tungkol kay Cristo, pwede nating sundin ang halimbawa ni Juan na matapang na ipahayag kung sino talaga si Jesus. Hindi na tayo mag-aalala sa sariling reputasyon kapag ini-highlight natin ang Isa na tunay na importante - si Jesus ang karapat-dapat sa lahat ng karangalan.
tl.godsLove: Nakikita natin ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa paraan na pinadala niya ang kanyang eternal Son na maging tao para sa atin. Hindi nanatiling malayo si Jesus sa langit kundi bumaba sa aming level, kahit na existed na siya bago pa ang lahat ng nilalang. Ipinakita nito ang amazing na puso ng Diyos - handa siyang pagbabaan ang sariling Anak para makilala natin siya personally at maligtas tayo.

en.understanding: John is telling us that Jesus is like an overflowing fountain of grace - He has so much that He can give endlessly to everyone. The phrase "grace upon grace" means wave after wave of God's undeserved favor, like ocean waves that never stop coming. This verse follows John the Baptist's testimony about Jesus, showing that Christ's abundance is available to all who receive Him.
en.livingItOut: When you feel empty, overwhelmed, or like you've used up all your second chances, remember that Jesus has unlimited grace for you. You can come to Him again and again - His grace never runs out, and He never gets tired of giving it. Start each day knowing that fresh grace is available, and let this truth help you extend grace to others too.
en.godsLove: This verse shows us God's heart - He doesn't give us just enough grace to get by, but abundant, overflowing grace! Like a loving parent who delights in spoiling their child with good gifts, God pours out blessing after blessing on us. His love is so generous that He holds nothing back, giving us everything we need and more through Jesus.

tl.understanding: Sinasabi ni Juan na si Jesus ay parang bukal na walang patid - sobrang dami ng biyaya niya na pwedeng ibigay sa lahat ng tao. Ang "biyaya sa ibabaw ng biyaya" ay parang mga alon sa dagat na walang tigil - sunod-sunod na pagmamahal ng Diyos na hindi natin deserve. Kasunod ito ng patunay ni Juan Bautista tungkol kay Jesus, na nagpapakita na ang kayamanan ni Cristo ay para sa lahat ng tumanggap sa kanya.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag pagod ka na, nalulunod sa problema, o pakiramdam mo ubos na ang mga second chance mo, alalahanin na walang hangganan ang biyaya ni Jesus para sa'yo. Pwede kang bumalik sa kanya ulit at ulit - hindi nauubos ang biyaya niya, at hindi siya nagsasawa sa pagbibigay. Simulan ang bawat araw na alam mong may fresh na biyaya na naghihintay, at hayaang tulungan ka nito na magbigay din ng biyaya sa iba.
tl.godsLove: Ipinakikita ng talatang ito ang puso ng Diyos - hindi lang sapat na biyaya ang binibigay niya, kundi sobra-sobrang biyaya! Parang magulang na natutuwa sa pagspoil sa anak niya ng mga magagandang regalo, ganyan din si God sa atin. Napakageneroso ng pagmamahal niya na walang itinago, binigay niya sa atin ang lahat ng kailangan natin at higit pa through kay Jesus.

en.understanding: John is making a beautiful comparison between two seasons of God's relationship with humanity. The law came through Moses to show us God's standards and our need for help, while grace and truth came through Jesus to actually meet that need. This isn't saying the law was bad, but that Jesus brought something even better - undeserved favor and the full revelation of who God really is.
en.livingItOut: When you mess up, remember you're not under a system of rules trying to earn God's approval anymore. You're under grace, which means God loves you completely because of Jesus, not because of your performance. Let this freedom from trying to be "good enough" fill you with gratitude and genuine love for others.
en.godsLove: God didn't leave us struggling under impossible standards forever. He sent Jesus to be everything we couldn't be and to give us what we didn't deserve - His own righteousness and endless grace. This shows us a God who doesn't just demand perfection but provides it as a gift, revealing His heart of incredible love and generosity toward us.

tl.understanding: Ginagawa ni Juan dito ang magandang paghahambing sa dalawang panahon ng pakikipag-ugnayan ng Diyos sa mga tao. Ang batas ay dumating kay Moises para ipakita sa atin ang mga pamantayan ng Diyos at ang aming pangangailangan ng tulong, habang ang biyaya at katotohanan ay dumating kay Jesus para talgang tuparin ang pangangailangang iyon. Hindi sinasabi rito na masama ang batas, kundi na nagdala si Jesus ng mas mahalagaing bagay - walang bayad na pabor at ang buong paghahayag kung sino talaga ang Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag nagkamali ka, tandaan mo na hindi ka na sa ilalim ng sistema ng mga tuntunin na sumusubok kumita ng pagmamahal ng Diyos. Nasa ilalim ka ng biyaya, na nangangahulugang lubos kang minamahal ng Diyos dahil kay Jesus, hindi dahil sa inyong ginagawa. Hayaan na ang kalayaang ito mula sa pagsisikap na maging "sapat na mabuti" ay magpuno sa iyo ng pasasalamat at tunay na pagmamahal sa iba.
tl.godsLove: Hindi tayo iniwan ng Diyos na nalulunod sa mga imposibleng pamantayan magpakailanman. Ipinadala Niya si Jesus para maging lahat ng hindi natin kaya at para bigyan tayo ng hindi natin karapat-dapat - ang Kanyang sariling katuwiran at walang hanggang biyaya. Ipinapakita nito sa atin ang Diyos na hindi lang nangangailangan ng kasakdalan kundi nagbibigay nito bilang regalo, na naghahayag ng Kanyang pusong puno ng kahanga-hangang pagmamahal at pagkamapagbigay sa atin.

en.understanding: John is telling us something amazing - no human has ever seen God the Father directly because He is pure spirit and too holy for us to look upon and live. But Jesus, who is fully God and has always been with the Father, came to earth to show us exactly what God is like. He's like a perfect translator, revealing God's character through His words, actions, and love.
en.livingItOut: When you want to know what God is really like, look at Jesus in the Gospels - how He treated people, what He said, how He loved. If you're wondering if God cares about your struggles, remember that Jesus wept with Mary and Martha. When you question if God forgives, see how Jesus treated the woman caught in adultery with such gentle mercy.
en.godsLove: This verse shows us God's incredible love - He didn't leave us guessing about His character or wondering if He cares. He sent Jesus to be the perfect picture of His heart, showing us that God is not distant or harsh, but loving, merciful, and full of grace. Every kind word Jesus spoke, every person He healed, every tear He shed reveals the tender heart of our Father.

tl.understanding: Sinasabi ni Juan na walang tao ang nakakita kay God the Father nang direkta kasi Siya ay purong espiritu at masyadong banal para sa atin. Pero si Jesus, na tunay na Diyos din at laging kasama ng Ama, bumaba sa mundo para ipakita kung ano talaga si God. Parang perfect translator Siya na nagpapakita ng ugali ng Diyos sa pamamagitan ng Kanyang mga salita, gawa, at pagmamahal.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag gusto mong malaman kung ano talaga si God, tingnan mo si Jesus sa mga Gospel - paano Niya tinrato ang mga tao, ano ang sinabi Niya, paano Niya minahal. Kung nagtatanong ka kung may pakialam ba si God sa mga problema mo, alalahanin mo na umiyak si Jesus kasama nina Mary at Martha. Kung nagdududa ka kung nagpapatawad ba si God, tignan mo kung paano tinrato ni Jesus ang babae na nahuli sa adultery nang napaka-gentle.
tl.godsLove: Ipinakikita ng talata na ito ang sobrang pagmamahal ng Diyos - hindi Niya tayo pinabayaan na mag-isip-isip kung ano ba talaga Siya o kung may pakialam ba Siya. Pinadalhan Niya tayo ni Jesus para maging perfect picture ng Kanyang puso, at ipakita na hindi Siya malayo o masungit, kundi mahabagin, mapagpatawad, at puno ng grace. Bawat mabait na salita ni Jesus, bawat taong pinagaling Niya, bawat luha na pumatak sa Kanyang mata ay nagpapakita ng maamong puso ng aming Ama.

en.understanding: The religious leaders in Jerusalem were curious and concerned about John the Baptist's ministry, so they sent official representatives to question him. These priests and Levites were the educated religious class who felt responsible for investigating anyone claiming to speak for God. John was drawing huge crowds and baptizing people, which made them wonder if he was claiming to be the promised Messiah.
en.livingItOut: When people question your faith or your changed life, be ready to give honest, humble answers like John did. Don't be defensive or prideful when others are curious about what God is doing in your life. Instead, see it as an opportunity to point them toward Jesus and share how He has transformed you.
en.godsLove: God's love is so amazing that it creates curiosity in others when they see His work in our lives! Just like John's ministry made people ask questions, when God transforms us, others notice and want to know more. God uses our changed lives as a magnet to draw people to Himself, showing how much He desires everyone to know Him.

tl.understanding: Ang mga pinuno ng relihiyon sa Jerusalem ay curious at nag-alala sa ministry ni Juan Bautista, kaya nagpadala sila ng mga opisyal na representative para tanungin siya. Ang mga pari at Levita na ito ay mga educated na religious class na nakaramdam ng responsibility na imbestigahan ang sinumang nag-claim na nagsasalita para sa Diyos. Maraming tao ang pumupunta kay Juan at nabibinyagan, kaya nagtaka sila kung nag-claim ba siyang Messiah.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag tinanong ka ng mga tao tungkol sa pananampalataya mo o sa pagbabago ng buhay mo, maging ready na magbigay ng honest at humble na sagot tulad ni Juan. Huwag maging defensive o proud kapag curious ang iba sa ginagawa ng Diyos sa buhay mo. Sa halip, tingnan ito bilang opportunity na ituro sila kay Jesus at i-share kung paano ka Niya nabago.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay sobrang amazing na nagiging curious ang iba kapag nakikita nila ang gawa Niya sa buhay natin! Tulad ng ministry ni Juan na naging dahilan para magtanong ang mga tao, kapag binago tayo ng Diyos, napapansin ng iba at gustong malaman pa. Ginagamit ng Diyos ang aming nabagong buhay bilang magnet para hilahin ang mga tao sa Kanya, nagpapakita kung gaano Niya gustong makilala siya ng lahat.

en.understanding: John the Baptist was being questioned by religious leaders who were curious about his identity and authority. Instead of being evasive or claiming to be someone greater, John boldly and clearly stated that he was NOT the promised Messiah. This shows John's honesty and humility - he could have gained followers by making false claims, but he chose truth over popularity.
en.livingItOut: Like John, we need to be honest about who we are and not pretend to be something we're not. When people praise us or when we're tempted to take credit for God's work, we should humbly point them to Jesus instead. True strength comes from knowing our place in God's story and being content with the role He's given us.
en.godsLove: God's love is shown in how He chose John - an ordinary man - for an extraordinary purpose. John didn't need to be the Messiah to be valuable to God; his role as the one who prepared the way was just as important. This reminds us that God loves us not for what we pretend to be, but for who we truly are in Him.

tl.understanding: Tinatanong si Juan Bautista ng mga lider sa relihiyon kung sino siya talaga at saan nanggaling ang kanyang kapangyarihan. Hindi siya nag-iwas o nag-claim na mas mataas siya, kundi malinaw niyang sinabi na hindi siya ang hinihintay na Mesias. Ipinakita niya dito ang kanyang katapatan at pagpapakumbaba - pwede siyang magsinungaling para makakuha ng maraming followers, pero pinili niya ang totoo kaysa sa popularity.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan, kailangan nating maging tapat sa kung sino talaga tayo at huwag magpanggap na iba tayo. Kapag pinupuri tayo ng mga tao o kapag natutukso tayong kunin ang credit sa ginagawa ng Diyos, dapat nating ituro sa kanila si Jesus. Ang tunay na lakas ay nanggagaling sa pagkakakilala natin sa aming lugar sa kwento ng Diyos at sa pagiging kontento sa role na binigay Niya sa atin.
tl.godsLove: Makikita natin ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa kung paano Niya pinili si Juan - isang ordinaryong tao - para sa isang extraordinary na layunin. Hindi kailangan ni Juan na maging Mesias para maging mahalaga sa Diyos; ang kanyang papel bilang naghanda ng daan ay kasing importante. Pinapaalala nito sa atin na minamahal tayo ng Diyos hindi dahil sa kung ano ang pinapanggap natin, kundi dahil sa kung sino talaga tayo sa Kanya.

en.understanding: The religious leaders keep pressing John the Baptist about his identity, asking if he's Elijah (who was expected to return) or "the Prophet" (referring to the prophet like Moses that God promised). John clearly says "no" to both questions. He refuses to claim any special titles or take credit that doesn't belong to him.
en.livingItOut: Like John, we need to be honest about who we are and not pretend to be something we're not. It's tempting to exaggerate our importance or take credit for what God has done through us. True humility means pointing people to Jesus, not ourselves.
en.godsLove: God loves humble hearts like John's! He doesn't need us to be someone else - He chose us exactly as we are to serve His purposes. When we're honest about our identity and point others to Jesus, we participate in God's beautiful plan to reveal His love to the world.

tl.understanding: Patuloy na tinatanong ng mga lider ng relihiyon si Juan Bautista kung sino ba talaga siya - kung si Elias ba siya (na inaasahan nilang babalik) o "ang Propeta" (yung propetang tulad ni Moises na ipinangako ng Diyos). Malinaw na sumagot si Juan ng "hindi" sa lahat ng tanong. Ayaw niyang mag-claim ng kahit anong titulo o kunin ang kredito na hindi naman sa kanya.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan, dapat tayo ring maging totoo sa kung sino tayo at hindi magpanggap na iba tayo sa tunay natin. Nakakaakit nga namang mag-exaggerate ng ating kahalagahan o kunin ang credit sa ginawa ng Diyos sa pamamagitan natin. Ang tunay na pagpapakumbaba ay ang pagturo sa iba na si Jesus ang important, hindi tayo.
tl.godsLove: Minamahal ng Diyos ang mga pusong mapagkumbaba tulad ni Juan! Hindi Niya kailangan na maging iba tayo - pinili Niya tayo exactly kung sino tayo para maglingkod sa Kanyang mga layunin. Kapag totoo tayo sa aming pagkatao at tinuturo namin ang iba kay Jesus, nakikibahagi tayo sa magandang plano ng Diyos na ipakita ang Kanyang pag-ibig sa mundo.

en.understanding: The religious leaders are getting frustrated with John the Baptist's answers. They've asked if he's the Christ, Elijah, or the Prophet, and he said no to all three. Now they're pressing him directly - "Just tell us who you are!" They need to report back to the Pharisees who sent them from Jerusalem.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes people will pressure us to define ourselves by their expectations or categories. Like John, we need to know our identity comes from God, not from what others want us to be. When questioned about our faith, we can speak with John's confidence and clarity about who God has called us to be.
en.godsLove: God's love gives us secure identity that doesn't depend on human approval or understanding. Just as God had a unique purpose for John the Baptist, He has a special calling for each of us. We don't need to fit into other people's boxes because we belong to the God who made us exactly as we are.

tl.understanding: Naiinis na ang mga lider ng relihiyon kay Juan Bautista dahil sa mga sagot niya. Tinanong nila kung siya ba ang Cristo, si Elias, o ang Propeta, pero lahat sinabi niyang hindi. Ngayon direkta na nila siyang tinatanong - "Sabihin mo na lang kung sino ka!" Kailangan nila ng sagot para sa mga Pariseo na nagpadala sa kanila.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan pipilitin tayo ng iba na idefine ang sarili natin base sa gusto nila. Tulad ni Juan, dapat natin malaman na ang tunay na pagkakakilanlan natin ay galing sa Diyos, hindi sa inaasahan ng iba. Kapag tinatanong tayo tungkol sa pananampalataya, maaari nating sagutin nang may tiwala tulad ni Juan.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay nagbibigay sa atin ng siguradong pagkakakilanlan na hindi umaasa sa approval ng tao. Tulad ng natatanging layunin na binigay ng Diyos kay Juan Bautista, mayroon din Siyang espesyal na tawag sa bawat isa sa atin. Hindi tayo kailangang magfit sa gusto ng iba dahil pag-aari tayo ng Diyos na gumawa sa atin nang eksakto.

en.understanding: When the religious leaders pressed John the Baptist about his identity, he didn't give his own opinion or try to make himself look important. Instead, he pointed them to Scripture - specifically to the prophet Isaiah who had written about his ministry 700 years earlier. John knew that God's Word was more trustworthy and powerful than anything he could say about himself.
en.livingItOut: When people ask about your faith or your purpose, let God's Word do the talking rather than relying on your own wisdom or trying to impress them. Make it a habit to know Scripture well enough that you can point others to what God says instead of just sharing your personal opinions. This builds your confidence on God's truth, not on how well you can argue or explain things.
en.godsLove: God loves us so much that He doesn't leave us guessing about our identity or purpose - He's already written it down for us in His Word. Just like He prepared Isaiah's prophecy centuries before John needed it, God has already provided everything we need to know about who we are in Him. His Word is His love letter, giving us confidence and direction when others question us.

tl.understanding: Nang tinanong ng mga relihiyosong lider si John the Baptist kung sino siya, hindi niya sinagot gamit ang sariling opinyon o hindi rin niya sinubukang gawing importante ang sarili. Sa halip, tinuro niya sila sa Kasulatan - sa propeta Isaiah na nagsulat tungkol sa kanyang ministeryo 700 taon na ang nakalipas. Alam ni John na ang Salita ng Diyos ay mas mapagkakatiwalaan at makapangyarihan kaysa sa kahit anong masasabi niya tungkol sa sarili.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag tinanong ka ng ibang tao tungkol sa inyong pananampalataya o layunin mo sa buhay, hayaang magsalita ang Salita ng Diyos sa halip na umasa sa sariling karunungan o subukang magpakaimportante. Gawing ugali na kilalaning mabuti ang Kasulatan para maturo mo sa iba kung ano ang sinasabi ng Diyos sa halip na magbahagi lang ng personal na opinyon. Mas lalakas ang tiwala mo sa katotohanan ng Diyos kaysa sa kakayahan mong makipag-debate o magpaliwanag.
tl.godsLove: Sobrang pagmamahal ng Diyos sa atin kaya hindi Niya tayo iniiwang naghuhulaan tungkol sa aming pagkakakilanlan o layunin - nakasulat na Niya ito para sa atin sa Kanyang Salita. Tulad ng paghahanda Niya ng propesiya ni Isaiah maraming siglo bago pa ito kailangan ni John, naihanda na rin ng Diyos ang lahat ng kailangan nating malaman tungkol sa kung sino tayo sa Kanya. Ang Kanyang Salita ay Kanyang love letter, nagbibigay sa atin ng kumpiyansa at direksyon kapag tinatanong tayo ng iba.

en.understanding: This verse introduces us to the religious leaders who were questioning John the Baptist. The Pharisees had sent representatives to investigate John's ministry and authority. They were the religious experts of their time, deeply concerned about maintaining proper religious order and suspicious of anyone claiming to speak for God.
en.livingItOut: When people question your faith or ask about your beliefs, respond with grace and truth like John did. Don't be intimidated by those who seem to have more religious knowledge or authority. Instead, be ready to share what God has done in your life with humility and confidence.
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient that He allows questions and investigation of His truth. Even when religious leaders came with skeptical hearts, God used this moment to reveal more about Jesus through John's testimony. God welcomes our honest questions and uses every conversation to draw people closer to Him.

tl.understanding: Ipinakikilala sa atin dito ang mga lider ng relihiyon na nagtatanong kay Juan Bautista. Nagpadala ang mga Pariseong mga eksperto sa batas ng Diyos para imbestigahan ang ministeryo ni Juan. Mga taong lubhang nagaalala sa tamang pag-sunod sa relihiyon at nag-dududa sa sinumang nagsasabing nagsasalita para sa Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag may mga taong nagtatanung sa inyong pananampalataya, tumugon kayo nang may biyaya at katotohanan tulad ni Juan. Huwag matakot sa mga taong tila mas maraming alam tungkol sa relihiyon. Sa halip, maging handang magbahagi ng ginawa ng Diyos sa inyong buhay nang may pagpapakumbaba at kumpiyansa.
tl.godsLove: Napakatiis ng pag-ibig ng Diyos na pinapayagan Niya ang mga tanong at pag-iimbestiga sa Kanyang katotohanan. Kahit na ang mga lider ng relihiyon ay naparito na may pagdududa, ginamit pa rin ng Diyos ang pagkakataong ito para ipahayag pa ang tungkol kay Jesus sa pamamagitan ni Juan. Tinatanggap ng Diyos ang aming mga tapat na tanong at ginagamit ang lahat ng usapan para palaitin tayo sa Kanya.

en.understanding: The religious leaders are questioning John the Baptist's authority to baptize people. In their minds, only someone really important - like the Messiah, Elijah, or a major prophet - would have the right to start this new practice. They're confused because John has denied being any of these figures, yet he continues baptizing with great boldness and crowds are flocking to him.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes we might question why God uses ordinary people to do extraordinary things, just like these leaders questioned John. Don't let others' doubts about your calling discourage you - if God has given you something to do, you don't need everyone's approval to obey Him. Keep serving faithfully, even when people question your qualifications or authority.
en.godsLove: God loves using unexpected people to prepare the way for His work! He chose John, who wasn't the Messiah but was faithful, to introduce Jesus to the world. This shows us that God doesn't need us to be perfect or have impressive titles - He just needs our willing hearts to be part of His beautiful plan.

tl.understanding: Tinatanong ng mga relihiyosong lider si Juan Bautista kung bakit siya nagbabautismo. Sa tingin nila, dapat lang ang mga importanteng tao - tulad ng Mesias, ni Elias, o ng malaking propeta - ang may karapatan mag-simula ng bagong gawain. Nalilito sila kasi sinabi ni Juan na hindi siya isa sa mga ito, pero patuloy pa rin siyang nagbabautismo at maraming tao ang pumupunta sa kanya.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan may mga taong magtatanong din kung bakit ginagamit ng Diyos ang mga ordinaryong tao para sa mga hindi ordinaryong bagay. Huwag kang mawawalan ng loob kapag may nagtanong sa'yo tungkol sa inyong tawag - kung binigay ng Diyos sa'yo ang trabaho, hindi mo na kailangan ng approval ng lahat para sumunod sa Kanya. Magpatuloy lang sa faithful na paglilingkod.
tl.godsLove: Mahal ng Diyos na gamitin ang mga taong hindi inaasahan para ihanda ang Kanyang gawa! Pinili Niya si Juan na hindi man ang Mesias pero tapat, para ipakilala si Jesus sa mundo. Pinapakita nito na hindi kailangan ng Diyos na perpekto tayo o may malaking titulo - kailangan lang Niya ng willing na puso natin para maging bahagi ng Kanyang magandang plano.

en.understanding: John the Baptist is responding to religious leaders who questioned his authority to baptize people. He humbly explains that his water baptism is just preparation - the real star of the show is someone they don't even recognize yet. Jesus was likely already walking among the crowds, but they had no idea who He really was.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes God is working right beside us, but we're too busy or distracted to notice. Ask God to open your eyes to see Him in your everyday moments - in conversations, circumstances, and opportunities. Stay humble like John, knowing that our role is simply to point others toward Jesus.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He doesn't just send help from heaven - He comes down and walks among us! Jesus didn't stay distant; He came close, living right in our neighborhoods and communities. Even when we don't recognize Him, He's there, ready to reveal Himself to hearts that are open to Him.

tl.understanding: Sinasagot ni Juan Bautista ang mga lider na nagtanong kung bakit siya nagbabautismo. Napakababang-loob niya na sinabi na ang kanyang tubig na bautismo ay paghahanda lang - ang tunay na bida ay nandoon na pero hindi pa nila nakikilala. Malamang na kasama na ni Jesus ang mga tao, pero walang nakakaalam kung sino talaga Siya.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan gumagana ang Diyos sa tabi natin, pero hindi natin napapansin kasi busy tayo o may ibang iniisip. Hilingin sa Diyos na buksan ang inyong mata para makita Siya sa araw-araw - sa mga usapan, pangyayari, at pagkakataon. Maging mababa ang loob tulad ni Juan, alam natin na trabaho natin ay ituro lang ang iba kay Jesus.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay napaka-personal na hindi lang Siya nagpapadala ng tulong galing sa langit - bumaba Siya at nakasama natin! Hindi naging malayo si Jesus; lumapit Siya, tumira sa aming mga kapitbahayan at komunidad. Kahit hindi natin Siya nakilala, nandyan Siya, handang ipakita ang sarili sa mga pusong bukas sa Kanya.

en.understanding: John the Baptist is declaring Jesus' supreme worth and authority by using a humble servant's image. In that culture, untying someone's sandals was the lowest task - something even servants wouldn't want to do. John is saying that compared to Jesus, he's not even worthy to do the most menial job for Him.
en.livingItOut: True humility means recognizing Jesus' greatness and our need for Him. When we face pride or feel self-important, remember John's example - he knew his role was to point people to Jesus, not to himself. Let this inspire us to serve others joyfully, knowing that serving is an honor, not beneath us.
en.godsLove: God's love is so amazing that He sent Someone so magnificent that even the greatest prophet felt unworthy to serve Him. Yet this same Jesus came to wash His disciples' feet and serve us! This shows God's incredible humility and love - the One who deserves all honor chose to serve and save us instead.

tl.understanding: Si Juan Bautista ay nagpapahayag ng kadakilaan ni Jesus gamit ang larawan ng pinakamababang gawain. Sa panahon nila, ang pagkakalas ng tali ng sapatos ay trabaho ng pinakamababang alipin - kahit mga katulong ay ayaw gawin ito. Sinasabi ni Juan na kumpara kay Jesus, hindi pa siya karapat-dapat na gumawa ng pinakamababang trabaho para sa Kanya.
tl.livingItOut: Ang tunay na pagpapakumbaba ay pag-amin sa kadakilaan ni Jesus at sa aming pangangailangan sa Kanya. Kapag nagiging mayabang tayo o feeling importante, alalahanin natin ang halimbawa ni Juan - alam niya na ang papel niya ay ituro si Jesus sa iba, hindi ang sarili niya. Magbigay inspirasyon ito sa atin na maglingkod sa iba nang masaya, dahil ang paglilingkod ay karangalan, hindi kahihiyan.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay napakaganda na nagpadala Siya ng Isang napakadakila na kahit ang pinakadakilang propeta ay naramdamang hindi karapat-dapat maglingkod sa Kanya. Pero ang parehong Jesus na ito ay naghugas ng paa ng mga alagad Niya at naglingkod sa atin! Ipinapakita nito ang napakagandang pagpapakumbaba at pag-ibig ng Diyos - ang Isang karapat-dapat sa lahat ng karangalan ay pumili na maglingkod at magligtas sa atin.

en.understanding: John the Gospel writer is giving us the specific location where John the Baptist was ministering - Bethany beyond the Jordan River. This wasn't the Bethany near Jerusalem where Mary, Martha, and Lazarus lived, but a different town on the east side of the Jordan. By mentioning this detail, John is showing us that these events really happened at a real place that people could visit and verify.
en.livingItOut: Just like John the Baptist had a specific place where God called him to serve, God has placed you exactly where you are for a purpose. Whether it's your neighborhood, workplace, or school, you can be His witness right where you are. You don't need to wait for a "better" location or situation - God wants to use you in your current circumstances.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He cares about the details - even recording the exact place where His plan unfolded. This shows us that our God is not distant or vague, but intimately involved in real places with real people. He knows exactly where you are today, and His love meets you right there in your specific situation.

tl.understanding: Sinasabi sa atin ni Juan kung saan eksaktong lugar nag-ministro si Juan Bautista - sa Bethany na nasa kabilang side ng Jordan River. Hindi ito 'yung Bethany malapit sa Jerusalem kung saan nakatira sina Mary, Martha, at Lazarus, kundi ibang bayan. Binabanggit ni Juan ang detalyeng ito para ipakita na tunay na nangyari ang mga bagay na ito sa totoong lugar.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan Bautista na may specific na lugar kung saan tinawag siya ng Diyos para maglingkod, inilagay ka rin ng Diyos sa eksaktong lugar kung nasaan ka ngayon para sa layunin Niya. Kahit sa inyong barangay, trabaho, o paaralan, pwede kang maging saksi Niya. Hindi mo kailangang maghintay ng "mas magandang" lugar - gusto ka ng Diyos gamitin sa kasalukuyan mong sitwasyon.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay napaka-personal na pati mga detalye ay binibigyang-pansin Niya - hanggang sa tukuyin pa kung saan eksaktong naganap ang plano Niya. Pinapakita nito na hindi malayo o malabo ang ating Diyos, kundi aktibong kasama natin sa mga totoong lugar. Alam Niya kung nasaan ka ngayon, at naroroon ang pag-ibig Niya para sa'yo sa inyong specific na sitwasyon.

en.understanding: John the Baptist sees Jesus approaching and makes an incredible declaration - Jesus is "the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world." This wasn't just a nice title; John was pointing to Jesus as the ultimate sacrifice that would replace all the temple lambs. While the daily sacrifices in the temple could only cover sins temporarily, Jesus would deal with sin once and for all.
en.livingItOut: When you feel weighed down by guilt or shame, remember John's words - Jesus takes away sin, not just covers it up. You don't have to carry that burden of past mistakes or current struggles with sin. Let this truth change how you see yourself and others - we're all people Jesus died to save, not enemies to judge.
en.godsLove: What amazing love that God would send His own Son to be the Lamb! God didn't wait for us to get our act together or prove we were worthy. While we were still sinners, He provided the solution through Jesus. This shows God's heart - He's not angry and distant, but loving and willing to sacrifice everything to bring us back to Him.

tl.understanding: Nakita ni Juan Bautista si Jesus na papalapit at nagsabi ng napakahalagang salita - si Jesus ang "Cordero ng Diyos na nag-aalis ng kasalanan ng mundo." Hindi lang ito magandang titulo; tinuturo ni Juan na si Jesus ang huling handog na papalit sa lahat ng mga cordero sa templo. Kung ang araw-araw na handog sa templo ay pansamantala lang na nakatakip sa kasalanan, si Jesus naman ang tuluyang aayos sa kasalanan.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag nararamdaman mo ang bigat ng guilt o shame, alalahanin ang sinabi ni Juan - si Jesus ang nag-aalis ng kasalanan, hindi lang nakatakip. Hindi mo kailangan dalhin ang bigat ng mga nakaraang pagkakamali o kasalukuyang pakikipagbuno sa kasalanan. Hayaang baguhin ng katotohanang ito kung paano mo nakikita ang sarili mo at ang iba - lahat tayo ay mga taong ipinagkamatay ni Jesus para maliligtas, hindi kaaway na hahatulan.
tl.godsLove: Napakagandang pag-ibig ng Diyos na ipadala ang Sariling Anak para maging Cordero! Hindi naghintay ang Diyos na maging okay muna tayo o patunayan na karapat-dapat tayo. Habang mga makasalanan pa tayo, binigay Na Niya ang solusyon sa pamamagitan ni Jesus. Ipinakikita nito ang puso ng Diyos - hindi Siya galit at malayo, kundi mapagmahal at handang magsakripisyo ng lahat para ibalik tayo sa Kanya.

en.understanding: John the Baptist is pointing to Jesus and explaining something amazing - even though Jesus came to ministry after John, Jesus is actually greater and existed before John was even born. John is acknowledging that Jesus is eternal, the Son of God who has always existed. This shows John's humility and his understanding of who Jesus really is.
en.livingItOut: Like John, we need to point others to Jesus and recognize His greatness in our lives. When we have opportunities to share about Jesus, we should do it with humility, knowing that He is far greater than us. We can follow John's example by stepping back and letting Jesus be the center of attention in our conversations and relationships.
en.godsLove: God's love is shown in how He sent Jesus, who existed from eternity, to come to earth for us. Jesus didn't have to come, but He chose to step into our world because of love. This verse reminds us that our Savior isn't just a good teacher - He's the eternal God who loves us enough to become human and save us.

tl.understanding: Si Juan Bautista ay nagtuturo kay Jesus at nagpapaliwanag ng isang kahanga-hangang bagay - kahit na si Jesus ay dumating sa ministry pagkatapos ni Juan, si Jesus ay mas dakila at umiiral na bago pa ipinanganak si Juan. Kinikilala ni Juan na si Jesus ay walang hanggan, ang Anak ng Diyos na laging umiiral. Nagpapakita ito ng pagkapakumbaba ni Juan at ng kanyang pag-unawa kung sino talaga si Jesus.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan, kailangan nating ituro ang iba kay Jesus at kilalanin ang Kanyang kadakilaan sa aming buhay. Kapag may pagkakataon tayong magkwento tungkol kay Jesus, dapat nating gawin ito nang may pagkapakumbaba, na alam nating mas dakila Siya sa atin. Maaari nating sundin ang halimbawa ni Juan sa pamamagitan ng pag-urong at pagpapaging sentro kay Jesus sa aming mga pag-uusap at relasyon.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay makikita sa kung paano Niya ipinadala si Jesus, na umiiral mula pa sa walang hanggan, para bumaba sa mundo para sa atin. Hindi kailangan ni Jesus na pumunta, pero pinili Niyang pumasok sa aming mundo dahil sa pag-ibig. Pinapaalala sa amin ng talatang ito na ang aming Tagapagligtas ay hindi lang magaling na guro - Siya ang walang hanggang Diyos na umibig sa atin nang sapat para maging tao at iligtas tayo.

en.understanding: John the Baptist admits something surprising - even though he was Jesus' cousin, he didn't recognize Jesus as the Messiah until God revealed it to him. John's whole ministry of baptizing people was actually part of God's plan to publicly introduce Jesus to Israel. This shows that even those closest to God's work sometimes need His revelation to see what He's doing.
en.livingItOut: Just like John, we might not always recognize how God is working around us until He opens our eyes. Stay humble and keep serving God faithfully, even when you don't see the full picture. Ask God to help you recognize His presence and work in your daily life - He wants to reveal Himself to you too.
en.godsLove: God lovingly prepared John's heart and ministry to be the perfect introduction for Jesus. He didn't leave Israel wondering who the Messiah was - He provided a clear witness through John. This shows how God carefully orchestrates events to reveal Himself to us, never leaving us to figure things out alone.

tl.understanding: Aminado si Juan Bautista na hindi niya nakilala si Jesus bilang Mesias kahit pinsan pa niya ito, hanggang sa ipahayag ito ng Diyos sa kanya. Ang buong ministeryo niya ng pagbabautismo ay bahagi ng plano ng Diyos para ipakilala si Jesus sa Israel. Nagpapakita ito na kahit yung mga malapit sa gawain ng Diyos, kailangan pa rin nila ng Kanyang paghahayag.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan, hindi natin laging nakikita kung paano gumagalaw ang Diyos sa paligid natin hanggang sa buksan Niya ang aming mata. Manatiling mapagkumbaba at patuloy na maglingkod sa Diyos nang tapat, kahit hindi mo nakikita ang buong larawan. Hilingin sa Diyos na tulungan ka niyang makilala ang Kanyang presensya sa araw-araw mong buhay.
tl.godsLove: Mahabagin na inihanda ng Diyos ang puso at ministeryo ni Juan para maging perpektong pagpapakilala kay Jesus. Hindi Niya iniwan ang Israel na naghuhulaan kung sino ang Mesias - nagbigay Siya ng malinaw na saksi sa pamamagitan ni Juan. Nagpapakita ito kung paano maingat na iniaayos ng Diyos ang mga pangyayari para ipakita ang Kanyang sarili sa atin.

en.understanding: John the Baptist is giving his eyewitness testimony about Jesus' baptism. When Jesus came up from the water, John saw the Holy Spirit come down from heaven and rest on Jesus like a gentle dove. This was God's way of showing John (and everyone watching) that Jesus was indeed the promised Messiah - the Spirit's presence was the divine sign John had been waiting for.
en.livingItOut: Just like John, we need to be ready to share what we've seen God do in our lives. When God shows us something special about Jesus or moves in our circumstances, we shouldn't keep it to ourselves. Look for opportunities to tell others about how you've experienced God's presence and work in your own life.
en.godsLove: God didn't leave John guessing about who Jesus was - He gave him a clear, beautiful sign. The gentle dove shows us God's tender love, not harsh or frightening, but peaceful and comforting. God loves us so much that He makes sure we can recognize His Son and His presence in our lives.

tl.understanding: Nagbibigay ng testimony si Juan Bautista tungkol sa nakita niya nung binautismuhan si Jesus. Pagkatapos lumabas si Jesus sa tubig, nakita ni Juan na bumaba ang Espiritu Santo mula sa langit at tumigil kay Jesus parang kalapati. Ito ang paraan ng Diyos para ipakita kay Juan (at sa lahat ng nakakita) na si Jesus nga ang hinihintay nilang Mesias.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan, dapat tayong ready na ikwento ang nakita nating ginawa ng Diyos sa buhay natin. Kapag may ipinakita sa atin ang Diyos tungkol kay Jesus o gumalaw Siya sa mga nangyayari sa atin, huwag nating itago. Hanapin natin ang pagkakataon na sabihin sa iba kung paano natin naranasan ang presensya at gawa ng Diyos.
tl.godsLove: Hindi hinayaan ng Diyos na manghula na lang si Juan kung sino si Jesus - binigyan Niya siya ng malinaw at magandang sign. Ang maamo na kalapati ay nagpapakita ng malambing na pag-ibig ng Diyos - hindi nakakatakot o masungit, kundi mapayapa at nakakacomfort. Sobrang mahal tayo ng Diyos kaya sinisigurado Niya na makikilala natin ang Kanyang Anak at ang Kanyang presensya sa buhay natin.

en.understanding: John the Baptist is explaining how God revealed Jesus' identity to him. Even though John was Jesus' cousin, he didn't recognize Jesus as the Messiah until God gave him a specific sign. God told John that whoever received the Spirit descending like a dove would be the one who baptizes with the Holy Spirit, not just water.
en.livingItOut: Like John, we need God to open our eyes to see Jesus clearly. Sometimes the people closest to us need our prayers and God's revelation to recognize who Jesus really is. We should ask God for spiritual discernment to recognize His work and presence in our daily lives.
en.godsLove: God lovingly provided John with a clear sign so he wouldn't miss recognizing Jesus. This shows how God doesn't leave us guessing about important spiritual truths - He gives us what we need to know Him. God's love ensures we have the guidance and revelation necessary to find and follow Jesus.

tl.understanding: Ine-explain ni Juan Bautista kung paano inihayag ng Diyos sa kanya ang tunay na pagkakakilanlan ni Jesus. Kahit pinsan ni Jesus si Juan, hindi niya nakilala si Jesus bilang Mesiyas hanggang sa bigyan siya ng Diyos ng tiyak na tanda. Sinabi ng Diyos kay Juan na kung sino ang makatanggap ng Espiritu na bumaba tulad ng kalapati, siya ang magbabautismo gamit ang Banal na Espiritu, hindi lang tubig.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan, kailangan natin ng Diyos para buksan ang aming mata upang makita nang malinaw si Jesus. Minsan ang mga taong malapit sa amin ay kailangan ng aming panalangin at revelasyon ng Diyos para makilala kung sino talaga si Jesus. Dapat nating hingin sa Diyos ang spiritual na pang-unawa para makilala ang Kanyang gawa at presensya sa aming araw-araw na buhay.
tl.godsLove: May pagmamahal na nagbigay ang Diyos kay Juan ng malinaw na tanda para hindi niya makaligtaan ang pagkilala kay Jesus. Nagpapakita ito na hindi tayo iniiwanan ng Diyos na naghuhula-hula tungkol sa mahahalagang spiritual na katotohanan - binibigyan niya tayo ng kailangan natin para makilala Siya. Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay nagsisiguro na mayroon tayong gabay at revelasyon na kinakailangan para mahanap at sundin si Jesus.

en.understanding: John the Baptist is making his boldest declaration yet - Jesus is the Son of God! This wasn't just John's opinion, but his testimony based on what he had personally witnessed when Jesus was baptized. The word "testified" here means John was giving official witness, like in a courtroom, declaring the truth he had seen with his own eyes.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, we're called to share what we've experienced about Jesus with others. You don't need to be a preacher - just tell people what you've seen God do in your life. When you've witnessed God's goodness, faithfulness, or love, that becomes your testimony to share with family, friends, and coworkers.
en.godsLove: God didn't leave us guessing about who Jesus really is - He gave clear signs and witnesses like John to point us to His Son. This shows how much God loves us and wants us to know Him personally. He provides testimony and evidence because He desires a real relationship with each of us, not blind faith.

tl.understanding: Si Juan Bautista ay nagsasabi ng pinakamahalagang pahayag niya - si Jesus ay Anak ng Diyos! Hindi ito opinyon lang ni Juan, kundi patunay base sa nakita niya mismo noong binautismuhan si Jesus. Ang salitang "nagpatunay" dito ay parang pagsaksi sa korte - sinasabi niya ang totoo base sa nakita niya mismo.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan Bautista, tayo rin ay tinawag na magbahagi ng aming naranasan tungkol kay Jesus. Hindi mo kailangang maging pastor - ikwento lang kung ano ang ginawa ng Diyos sa buhay mo. Kapag nakita mo ang kabutihan, tapat na pag-ibig, o gawa ng Diyos, yun na ang inyong patunay na pwedeng ibahagi sa pamilya at mga kaibigan.
tl.godsLove: Hindi tayo pinabayaan ng Diyos na mag-isip kung sino talaga si Jesus - nagbigay Siya ng mga tanda at saksi tulad ni Juan para ituro sa atin ang Kanyang Anak. Ipinappakita nito kung gaano Niya tayo kamahal at gustong makilala natin Siya nang personal. Nagbibigay Siya ng patunay dahil gusto Niya ng tunay na relasyon sa bawat isa sa atin.

en.understanding: After declaring Jesus as the Son of God, John the Baptist continues his ministry the next day with two of his followers nearby. This simple scene sets up one of the most important moments in the Gospel - when these disciples will encounter Jesus personally. John is faithful to keep pointing people toward Christ, even in ordinary, everyday moments.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, we should consistently point others to Jesus in our daily lives, not just in special moments. Whether we're with friends, family, or coworkers, we can look for natural opportunities to share about Christ's love. Our witness doesn't always need grand gestures - sometimes the most powerful testimonies happen in simple, everyday conversations.
en.godsLove: God orchestrates ordinary moments to bring extraordinary encounters with Jesus. He doesn't waste any day or situation in His plan to draw people to Himself. Just as He used this simple day with John and his disciples, God can use your regular days and relationships to show His love to others who need to meet Jesus.

tl.understanding: Pagkatapos niyang ideklara na si Jesus ay Anak ng Diyos, nagpatuloy si Juan Bautista sa kanyang ministeryo kinabukasan kasama ang dalawa niyang alagad. Ang simpleng eksena na ito ay naghahanda sa isa sa pinakamahalagang sandali sa Ebanghelyo - kung kailan makakatagpo ng personal ang mga alagad na ito si Jesus. Tapat si Juan na patuloy na ituturo ang mga tao kay Cristo, kahit sa ordinaryong araw-araw na mga sandali.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan Bautista, dapat nating patuloy na ituro ang iba kay Jesus sa aming pang-araw-araw na buhay, hindi lang sa mga espesyal na sandali. Kapag kasama natin ang mga kaibigan, pamilya, o katrabaho, maaari nating hanapin ang natural na pagkakataon para magbahagi tungkol sa pag-ibig ni Cristo. Hindi palaging kailangan ng mga malalaking gawa ang aming pagsaksi - minsan ang pinakamalakas na patunay ay nangyayari sa mga simpleng, araw-araw na pag-uusap.
tl.godsLove: Ginagamit ng Diyos ang ordinaryong mga sandali para magdala ng hindi ordinaryong pakikipagtagpo kay Jesus. Hindi Niya nasasayang ang kahit anong araw o sitwasyon sa Kanyang plano na malapit ang mga tao sa Kanya. Tulad ng paggamit Niya sa simpleng araw na ito kasama si Juan at ang kanyang mga alagad, maaari ring gamitin ng Diyos ang inyong regular na mga araw at relasyon para ipakita ang Kanyang pag-ibig sa ibang nangangailangan makilala si Jesus.

en.understanding: John the Baptist sees Jesus walking nearby and immediately points Him out to his disciples as "the Lamb of God." This wasn't just a casual observation - John was deliberately directing his followers' attention to Jesus. The title "Lamb of God" connected Jesus to the sacrificial lambs used in temple worship, showing that Jesus would be the ultimate sacrifice for sin.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, we should point others toward Jesus whenever we have the opportunity. This means being ready to share about Jesus naturally in our conversations and daily interactions.
